exercises.title: COTS implementation 1 — which kind of implementation requirement?
exercises.problemHtml:
Five kinds of requirements for implementing a package: configuration (setting parameters), integration (interfaces with other applications), extension (new functionality to close a gap), data (mapping your data to the package’s) and business process changes (adapting your processes to the package). Classify.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Năm loại yêu cầu khi triển khai gói có sẵn.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

# COTS implementation 1 — which kind of implementation requirement? — answer key

1. Choose the right value for every row.Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.
   - r0.k: Configuration
   - r1.k: Integration
   - r2.k: Extension
   - r3.k: Data
   - r4.k: Business process changes
   Most successful COTS implementations rely on configuration; extensions should be the exception.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Most successful COTS implementations rely on configuration; extensions should be the exception.

bang.de:
Choose the right value for every row.

Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.

o.s: Set the slot length parameter to 15 minutes and opening hours to 07:00–20:00.
Send every e-prescription from the package to the national system.
Build a custom family-booking module because the package has none.
Map our "visit type" codes to the package’s "service category" field.
Receptionists will confirm bookings in the package instead of in a paper book.

bang.giaiThich: Most successful COTS implementations rely on configuration; extensions should be the exception.

mistakesJson.loi: Gọi ánh xạ dữ liệu là integration.
Coi thay đổi quy trình không phải yêu cầu.

exercises.title: COTS implementation 2 — what to do with each gap
exercises.problemHtml:
For each gap between what you need and what the package delivers, decide: ignore it (drop the requirement and live with the tool), change your process (do it outside the solution), or build a bridge (extend the package). Choose the most reasonable option.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Với mỗi khoảng trống: bỏ qua, đổi quy trình, hay xây cầu nối (mở rộng)?

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

hintsJson: Bắt buộc theo luật ⇒ xây cầu nối.

exercises.title: COTS implementation 3 — configuration and process
exercises.problemHtml:
Define configuration requirements one process flow, use case or story at a time, walking through the vendor’s documentation. A package is usually chosen to be cheaper than custom software — so the organisation adapts its processes to the package, the reverse of custom development.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: COTS implementation 4 — users and expectations
exercises.problemHtml:
As with any project, engage users in selection or early implementation so their needs are met — otherwise they may reject the solution. A package that looks great in a demo may not behave as expected after installation.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
